author: 20th Century Studios YouTube
text:
Pour yourself a cup of ambition ☕️✨ 9 to 5 returns to theaters for a limited time on October 9.
Get your tickets now! Join us in honoring Dolly Parton's legacy by seeing 9 to 5 in theaters October 9-15, 2026. Disney will donate 100% of its net proceeds* from each U.S. ticket purchase to CAF America who will grant the funds to The Dollywood Foundation, home of Dolly Parton's Imagination Library. Learn more at cafamerica.org and dollywoodfoundation.org
 
*Net proceeds refers to the amount actually received by Disney from the U.S. theatrical ticket sale for the film during the period October 9-15, 2026, less (a) amounts retained by exhibitors, (b) third-party distribution fees and expenses, (c) third-party marketing and advertising expenses incurred in connection with the campaign, and (d) CAF America's administrative fees.
